heading: Art. 77. Principals
lead: Any person punishable under this chapter who— is a principal.

tree.text: commits an offense punishable by this chapter, or aids, abets, counsels, commands, or procures its commission; or
causes an act to be done which if directly performed by him would be punishable by this chapter;
